newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria cuts Oct light crude, raises others -trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria cuts Oct light crude, raises others -trade.

text.p: Nigeria cut the October price of most of its crudes, including Bonny Light and Qua Iboe, but raised the price of Forcados and Bonny Medium, traders said.
Bonny Light and Qua Iboe were both cut by seven cents to Dated Brent +36 cents.
Escravos fell by eight cents to Dated +32 cents, Brass shed nine cents to +38 cents and Pennington lost two to +64 cents.
Meanwhile, Forcados was raised by 13 cents to Dated +36 cents and Bonny Medium gained 18 cents to +28 cents.
Nigeria National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) left the premium payable for deferred pricing unchanged at +9 cents.
Traders said the new prices were in line with market expectations.
